Routes.title: Routes
Routes.intro: Manage station pairs, estimated journey duration and route availability.
Routes.formHint: A route is directional. Origin and destination must be different.
Routes.deleteHint: Delete {name}? Routes linked to trips cannot be deleted.
Routes.exists: A route in this direction already exists.
Routes.hasTrips: This route has trips. Create another route to change its stations.
Routes.inUse: This route is in use and cannot be deleted.
Routes.notFound: This route no longer exists. Refresh the list.
Routes.missingStation: A selected station no longer exists. Refresh the list.
Routes.readFailedHint: Refresh to load complete routes and station choices.
Routes.staleHint: The displayed records may be out of date. Refresh before making changes.
Routes.emptyHint: Adjust the filters or add a route after creating its stations.

Trips.title: Trips
Trips.intro: Manage departures, assigned buses and fares. Times are shown in Cairo time.
Trips.timeHint: All dates and times use Cairo time. Repeated or skipped daylight-saving times are rejected.
Trips.hasBookings: Trips with reservations cannot be edited. Use the authorized cancellation flow when needed.
Trips.inUse: This trip is referenced and cannot be deleted.
Trips.missingOption: A selected route or bus no longer exists. Refresh the list.
Trips.alreadyCancelled: This trip was cancelled and cannot be changed.
Trips.conflict: The bus has a conflicting departure. Refresh and choose another time or bus.
Trips.inactive: Choose an active route and bus.
Trips.unresolved: Payments need reconciliation before this trip can be cancelled.
Trips.cancelHint: Cancel this departure and prepare full refunds for confirmed bookings. Refunds must be issued separately by a super admin.
Trips.cancelledNotice: Trip cancelled. Review the full refund obligations.
Trips.deleteHint: Delete this unused trip? Trips linked to bookings cannot be deleted.
Trips.readFailedHint: Refresh to load the list and all route/bus choices.
Trips.staleHint: The displayed records may be out of date. Refresh before making changes.
Trips.emptyHint: Change the filters or add a departure with an active route and bus.
Trips.batchHint: Choose up to 90 days and review every generated departure before creating trips.
Trips.readyToCreate: Preview is ready. Schedule conflicts will be checked again when creating trips.
Trips.conflictsFound: Resolve all schedule conflicts before creating this batch.
Trips.invalidTime: A Cairo departure time is repeated or skipped by a daylight-saving change. Choose another time.
Trips.noDepartures: No departures match the selected days and date range.

Bookings.title: Bookings
Bookings.intro: Find bookings by complete reference, exact email or travel date. Travel dates use Cairo time.
Bookings.detailsHint: Recorded booking and passenger information. Passengers cannot cancel bookings.
Bookings.readFailedHint: Refresh to load current records. Displayed records may be out of date.
Bookings.emptyHint: Check the exact reference or email, or clear the filters.

Payments.title: Payment records
Payments.intro: Recorded payment attempts and outcomes. The date filter uses attempt creation day in Cairo, not travel day.
Payments.detailsHint: Latest recorded payment evidence and provider references. Opening this record does not contact the payment provider.
Payments.requiresReview: This payment requires review. Its outcome is not confirmed.
Payments.readFailedHint: Refresh to load current records. Displayed records may be out of date.
Payments.emptyHint: Check the exact identifiers or email, or clear the filters.

Refunds.title: Refunds
Refunds.intro: Full refund obligations and recorded outcomes. Only super administrators may issue or reconcile refunds.
Refunds.refreshFirst: Close this dialog and refresh the list before another action; the previous outcome is uncertain.
Refunds.issueHint: Issue a full refund of {amount}? This sends a financial request and cannot be undone here.
Refunds.reconcileHint: Check the recorded refund of {amount} against provider evidence. This does not resend a refund request.
Refunds.updated: Refund record updated. Check its recorded status.
Refunds.reviewRequired: Verified payment evidence is required. Review this refund before proceeding.
Refunds.unavailable: Payment verification is unavailable. Refresh later before trying another action.
Refunds.readFailedHint: Refresh to load current refund records.
Refunds.emptyHint: Refund obligations appear when a paid booking cannot be fulfilled or its trip is cancelled.

Users.title: Passengers
Users.intro: Find passenger accounts by exact email or international phone number. Suspending an account revokes its sessions.
Users.administratorsIntro: Manage existing administrator accounts. Keep at least one active, verified super administrator.
Users.promoteUser: Find a verified passenger to grant administrator access
Users.name: Name
Users.suspendHint: Suspend {name}? Active sessions will be revoked.
Users.activateHint: Activate {name}? The account must still satisfy sign-in requirements.
Users.roleHint: Change access for {name}. Role changes revoke active sessions; an administrator account must be active and email-verified.
Users.lastSuper: Keep at least one active, verified super administrator.
Users.notReady: Activate and verify this account before assigning an administrator role.
Users.notFound: This account no longer exists in this list. Refresh the records.
Users.readFailedHint: Refresh to load current accounts. Displayed records may be out of date.
Users.emptyHint: Check the exact email or phone, or clear the filters.
